rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Associating another with God in existence is an enduring creedal wretchedness, unlike practical sin, because it posits a rival existence beside His.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى أن الشقاوة العلمية الاعتقادية مخلدة لا تتدارك أبدا دون العملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Self-purification by the self is impossible because the ego’s qualities are inherent and necessarily endure with it.
rows.anchor: يزيلون صفات نفوسهم بنفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites the warning about guarding the soul from greed as evidence that vices are mixed into it and persist with it.
rows.anchor: إذ هي لوازم النفس باقية لازمة لها

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: A Prophetic saying calls the worst person the one upon whom resurrection comes while still alive.
rows.anchor:
وقال عليه الصلاة والسلام:
" شر الناس من قامت عليه القيامة وهو حي "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The saying describes one who reaches knowledge of tawhid before the ego dies through annihilation and lives through God; he then becomes a heretic who permits everything.
rows.anchor: يقف على علم التوحيد ونفسه لم تمت بالفناء حتى تحيى بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God purifies whom He wills by erasing their qualities and removing them through His own attributes.
rows.anchor: بمحو صفاته وإزالتها بصفاته تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not withhold even a tiny amount of the soul’s attributes or their due: He exchanges weak, fleeting qualities for His strong, lasting attributes.
rows.anchor: فإن الله لا يأخذ شيئا منها مع ضعفها وسرعة انقضائها حتى يعطي بدله من صفاته مع قوتها ودوامها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their lie is either claiming that their souls have been purified when they have not, or appropriating God’s attributes while their own selves remain.
rows.anchor: بانتحال صفات الله إلى أنفسهم لوجود نفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelief in the signs means being veiled from God’s manifestations in attributes and acts; the passage opens with His manifestation through knowledge, wisdom, and sovereignty in Abraham’s household.
rows.anchor: حجبوا عن تجليات صفاتنا وأفعالنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One possible fire is the longing for perfection demanded by their natures and capacities while their veil remains firmly rooted.
rows.anchor: نار شوق الكمال لاقتضاء غرائزهم وطبائعهم بحسب استعدادهم ذلك مع رسوخ الحجاب ولزومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, it is the fire of coercion arising from manifestations of God’s overpowering attributes, in a form suited to their states.
rows.anchor: نار قهر من تجليات صفات قهره تناسب أحوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A third reading makes the fire their own evil selves and the intense craving for qualities and pleasures they were habituated to but are denied.
rows.anchor: نار شره نفوسهم وحدة شوقها وطلبها لما ضريت بها من كمالات صفاتها وشهواتها مع حرمانها عنها

words: كُلَّمَا نَضِجَتْ جُلُودُهُم بَدَّلْنَٰهُمْ جُلُودًا غَيْرَهَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As they shed bodily coverings, those veils are lifted and replaced by new ones, so they continue tasting the fires of deprivation.
rows.anchor: حجبا غيرها جديدة { ليذوقوا العذاب } نيران الحرمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s might subdues and humiliates them through their own soul-qualities, burning them with longing for perfections they are forever denied.
rows.anchor: قويا يقهرهم ويذلهم بذل صفات نفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s wisdom gives them punishment suited to what they chose through angry and appetitive impulses and their attraction to bodily pleasures, exchanging one dark veil for another.
rows.anchor: يجازيهم بما يناسبهم من العذاب الذي اختاروه لأنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people deny the punishment, which is a fixed reality that will descend upon them.
rows.anchor: بهذا العذاب { قومك وهو الحق } الثابت النازل بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The speaker is not charged with guarding them or preventing this punishment.
rows.anchor: بموكل يحفظكم ويمنعكم من هذا العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything foretold has a place and time at which it will occur and become established.
rows.anchor: ما ينبأ عنه محل وقوع واستقرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will know when bodily coverings are removed and the pain appears in forms dictated by their souls.
rows.anchor: حين يكشف عنكم أغطية أبدانكم فيظهر عليكم ألم هذا العذاب بصور ما تقتضيه نفوسكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Engaging in God’s signs means projecting the self’s qualities and affirming its own knowledge and power; such people are veiled and associators.
rows.anchor: صفاتنا بإظهار صفات نفوسهم وإثبات العلم والقدرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One should turn away because they are veiled and associate others with God.
rows.anchor: لا { فأعرض عنهم } فإنهم محجوبون مشركون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan’s distraction comes through seductive falsehoods and the self’s whispering; displaying one’s own qualities makes one resemble them and incline toward their company.
rows.anchor: وسوسة نفسك فتظهر ببعض صفاتها وتجانسهم بذلك فتميل إلى صحبتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After God reminds him, the Prophet must not sit with those who place their own qualities where God’s qualities belong and veil the divine with themselves.
rows.anchor: الذين ظلموا أنفسهم بوضع صفاتهم موضع صفاتي وحجبوها بصفاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their company can itself cause a temporary shift into veiling, so the warning protects against the harm of companionship.
rows.anchor: فإن صحبتهم تؤثر فيوشك أن تقع في الاحتجاب بشؤم صحبتهم على سبيل التلوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God splits the heart’s seed through spirit-light into knowledge and gnosis, and the soul’s kernel through heart-light into morals and virtues.
rows.anchor: حبة القلب بنور الروح عن العلوم والمعارف ونوى النفس بنور القلب عن الأخلاق والمكارم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At times the living heart emerges from the dead soul when the spirit’s light overcomes it; at other times, desire and soul-qualities overcome the living heart and return it to death.
rows.anchor: نور الروح عليها { ومخرج } ميت النفس عن حي القلب أخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God can turn people through changing states and stages, so the author asks how they turn away from Him to another.
rows.anchor: القادر على تقليب أحوالكم وتغليبكم في أطواركم { فأنى } تصرفون منه إلى غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dawn is the splitting of the darkness of soul-qualities away from the heart by the rising light of the spirit’s sun.
rows.anchor: فالق ظلمة صفات النفس عن القلب بإصباح نور شمس الروح وإشراقه عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is either the soul’s darkness in which the heart sometimes rests and recovers, or the station where bodily faculties settle from agitation.
rows.anchor: ظلمة النفس سكن القلب يسكن إليها للارتفاق والاسترواح أحيانا أو سكنا تسكن فيه القوى البدنية وتستقر عن الاضطراب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun and moon are the spirit and heart, counted among the noble, enduring existents and held in esteem.
rows.anchor: وشمس الروح وقمر القلب محسوبين في عداد الموجودات الباقية الشريفة، معتدا بهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the sun and moon are a reckoning or knowledge by which conditions and times are measured.
rows.anchor: أو علمي حسب الأحوال والأوقات تعتبر بهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the states of disclosure and veiling, alternately manifesting, overpowering, and annihilating the spirit and heart, and acts with wisdom.
rows.anchor: بأحوال البروز والانكشاف والتستر والاحتجاب بهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stars are the senses: they guide through the body’s land to livelihood and through the heart’s sea to acquired knowledge.
rows.anchor: بر الأجساد إلى مصالح المعاش وبحر القلوب باكتساب العلوم بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs detailed for knowers are the spirit, the heart, and the senses.
rows.anchor: أي: الروح والقلب والحواس { لقوم يعلمون } ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The single soul from which people are made is the universal soul.
rows.anchor: هي النفس الكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul’s place of settling is the bodily earth during manifestation, while its deposit is the station of the essence’s unitive gathering during annihilation.
rows.anchor: في أرض البدن حال الظهور { ومستودع } في عين جمع الذات حال الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs are the soul’s manifestation, settlement, and deposit, understood through illuminated hearts and clear discernment.
rows.anchor: آيات ظهور النفس واستقرارها واستيداعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rain from the spirit’s heaven is the water of knowledge, which brings forth every class of moral quality and virtue.
rows.anchor: ماء العلم { فأخرجنا به نبات } كل صنف من الأخلاق والفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The green growth is the soul’s fresh, verdant form, beautified and gladdened by knowledge and character.
rows.anchor: من النبات هيئة خضرة النفس وزينة حسنة جميلة وبهجة بالعلم والخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The grains are ordered, noble, accepted deeds and sincere intentions that strengthen the heart.
rows.anchor: أعمالا مترتبة شريفة مرضية، ونيات صادقة يتقوى بها القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The date palm is the intellect; as its attachments emerge, it yields accessible knowledge and truths made nearly self-evident by spirit-light.
rows.anchor: ومن نخل العقل من ظهور تعلقها معارف وحقائق قريبة التناول لظهورها بنور الروح كأنها بديهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Grape gardens signify spiritual states and tastes, especially kinds of heart-love whose juice and pure wine intoxicate.
rows.anchor: الأحوال والأذواق وخصوصا أنواع المحبة القلبية المسكر عصيرها وسلافها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Olives represent reflection, while pomegranates represent true conjectures, lofty aspirations, and precious resolve.
rows.anchor: وزيتون التفكر، ورمان التوهمات الصادقة التي هي الهمم الشريفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some fruits resemble one another, like intellectual reflection, knowledge, deeds, intentions, or love of essence and attributes; others differ, including kinds of love and their ranks, strength, and visibility.
rows.anchor: كالتعقلات والتفكرات والمعارف والحقائق والأعمال والنيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: During the path and the beginning of a spiritual state, one should watch its fruit through vigilant self-observation and turn attention from pleasures toward these fruits.
rows.anchor: وليكن نظركم من اللذات إلى هذه الثمرات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ripening signifies perfection at arrival through spiritual presence.
rows.anchor: وكماله عند الوصول بالحضور

words: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These are signs for those with knowledge-based faith who affirm the enumerated signs and spiritual states.
rows.anchor: ويوقنون هذه الآيات والأحوال التي عددناها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is tawhid and surrendering oneself to God, with no turn toward image over meaning or toward another besides God.
rows.anchor: طريق التوحيد وإسلام الوجه إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs are gnoses and realities embedded in people’s capacities, by which they find guidance.
rows.anchor: المعارف والحقائق التي هي مركوزة في استعدادهم فيهتدوا بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The abode of peace is safety from every defect, affliction, fear of an attribute appearing, or remnant of selfhood.
rows.anchor: السلامة من كل نقص وآفة وخوف ظهور صفة ووجود بقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being with their Lord means being in the presence of His attributes or, alternatively, the presence of His essence.
rows.anchor: في حضرة صفاته أو حضرة ذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s guardianship gives them His love and perfection, shelters them in His attributes and essence, and makes them eternally secure after their passing-away through inward and bodily works on the path.
rows.anchor: يعطيهم محبته وكماله، ويدخلهم في ظل صفاته وذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The day of gathering is the day of absolute unitive gathering, when the jinn are the powers of the lower self.
rows.anchor: قلنا { يا معشر } جن القوى النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humans whom the psychic powers amassed may be the outer senses and limbs, which they induce to obey through worldly trinkets, physical pleasures, and sinful whisperings.
rows.anchor: من الحواس والأعضاء الظاهرة أو من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the amassed humans are human forms that the psychic powers make their followers through seductive worldly goods and bodily delights.
rows.anchor: الصور الإنسانية بأن جعلتموهم أتباعكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mutual enjoyment is each side benefiting from the other within their collective form.
rows.anchor: بانتفاع كل منا في صورة الجمعية بالآخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their appointed term may be death or bodily resurrection in the ugliest form and most wretched life.
rows.anchor: بالموت أو بالمعاد الجسماني على أقبح الصور وأسوأ العيش

words: ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is deprivation from pleasures and the experience of pain; the exception may mean a respite or the rescue of those whose belief in shirk was not firmly rooted.
rows.anchor: نار الحرمان عن اللذات ووجدان الآلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s wisdom punishes according to acquired soul-dispositions; His knowledge distinguishes those punished endlessly for belief from those punished temporarily for evil deeds and then released.
rows.anchor: لا يعذبكم إلا بهيآت نفوسكم التي كسبتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pious avoid shirk; Satan’s touch is attributing an act to someone besides God, and recollection of tawhid makes them see God’s agency alone.
rows.anchor: الشرك { إذا مسهم طائف } لمسة { من الشيطان } بنسبة الفعل إلى الغير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The brothers of devils are veiled people who persist in stubbornness, disputation, and ignorance by attributing acts to other than God.
rows.anchor: وإخوان الشياطين من المحجوبين { يمدونهم } في نسبة الفعل إلى غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge means: why did you not gather or compose the sign on your own?
rows.anchor: أي: هلا اجتمعتها من تلقاء نفسك

words: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ مِن رَّبِّى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet does not fabricate for himself; he conveys from God and speaks only what is revealed because he is established through God, not his own self.
rows.anchor: بل أبلغ عن الله ولا أقول إلا ما يوحى إلي منه به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Listening to the Quran means listening to God and listening only from Him.
rows.anchor: إلى الله ولا تستمعوا إلا منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Be silent from self-talk and everything besides God, since God is the one speaking in the recitation.
rows.anchor: فإن المتكلم به هو الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may receive mercy through the manifestation of the speaker in His speech with His attributes and acts.
rows.anchor: برحمة تجلي المتكلم في كلامه بصفاته وأفعاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remember God as present within yourself, following the cited example of the Messenger of God.
rows.anchor: حاضرا { في نفسك } كقوله تعالى:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humility in remembrance belongs to the station of differentiation within unity.
rows.anchor: في مقام التفصيل للجمع { وخيفة } في السر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear is inward fear of the self or fear that the self may claim a share in remembrance.
rows.anchor: في السر من النفس أو خيفة أن يكون للنفس فيه نصيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remembrance should not appear as the self’s public display; one should remember through God and for God, at dawn with spirit-light and at dusk under the self’s powers.
rows.anchor: أي: دون أن يظهر لك التضرع والذكر منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not be heedless at any time, especially when the self’s traits dominate; remain aware of essential unity.
rows.anchor: في حال من الأحوال، وخصوصا حال غلبات النفس وصفاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers addressed are those who believe in the unseen.
rows.anchor: { يا أيها الذين آمنوا } بالغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Respond by purification and refinement to what gives the heart life through true knowledge, or actualize faith and follow the path to God so He gives you life.
rows.anchor: بالتزكية والتصفية { إذا دعاكم لما } يحيي قلوبكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If answering God and the Messenger is one response, the preceding account applies; if distinct, answer God inwardly through heart-works and the Messenger outwardly through works of the self.
rows.anchor: استجيبوا لله بالباطن والأعمال القلبية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another distinction is to answer God through annihilation in unity and answer the Messenger by observing differentiated obligations and abiding through God.
rows.anchor: بالفناء في الجمع، وللرسول بمراعاة حقوق التفصيل

words: أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Act before readiness vanishes: God may come between a person and the heart by removing preparedness and producing a veil through sin’s rust.
rows.anchor: قبل زوال الاستعداد فإن الله يحول بين المرء وقلبه بزوال الاستعداد وحصول الحجاب بارتكاب الرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the gathering to God, He repays each person from His attributes and essence according to their effacement and annihilation.
rows.anchor: فيجازيكم من صفاته وذاته على حسب محوكم وفنائكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fitna to be feared is associating others with God and becoming veiled.
rows.anchor: شركا وحجابا

words: لَا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers misuse or diminish their preparedness; one reading takes the warning as saying that, if the fitna strikes, it strikes those wrongdoers specifically.
rows.anchor: بإزالة الاستعداد أو نقصه لاستعماله

words: لَا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the fitna does not strike only them: bad company spreads their vice to others, as corruption has spread on land and sea through people’s deeds.
rows.anchor: بل تشملهم وغيرهم بشؤم صحبتهم وتعدي رذيلتهم إلى من يخالطهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Severe punishment is the dark dispositions acquired by hearts being imposed on them, veiling them from God and tormenting them.
rows.anchor: بتسليط الهيآت الظلمانية التي اكتسبتها القلوب عليها وحجبها عنه وتعذيبها بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He says the booty allocation resists taʾwil in light of what is reported in al-Wāqiʿa, but offers an existential application if desired.
rows.anchor: لا يقبل التأويل بحسب ما ورد فيه من (الواقعة)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the spiritual faculties, the spoils are beneficial sciences and the five foundational teachings; God’s fifth is the testimony of divine unity and Muhammad’s messengership as unitive tawhid, and the Messenger is the heart.
rows.anchor: وهو شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله

words: وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inner allocation, kin are the secret; orphans are the theoretical and practical intellects; the needy are the psychic powers; and the wayfarer is the traveling soul estranged from its original home.
rows.anchor: { ولذي القربى } الذي هو السر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remaining four fifths are apportioned among the bodily limbs, organs, and natural faculties.
rows.anchor: والأخماس الأربعة الباقية تقسم على الجوارح والأركان والقوى الطبيعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True faith in God means unitive faith; the Day of Criterion is the moment of differentiation after union, when spiritual and psychic forces meet in differentiated witnessing within unity.
rows.anchor: وقت التفرقة بعد الجمع تفصيلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near bank is the city of knowledge and the seat of rational discrimination.
rows.anchor: من مدينة العلم ومحل العقل الفرقاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The far bank is the lower direction, remote from truth and the abode of knowledge; the caravan below is the natural faculties distinguished from psychic faculties.
rows.anchor: الجهة السفلية البعيدة من الحق ومحل العلم وركب القوى الطبيعية الممتازة للقوى النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had they arranged the encounter through reason and wisdom rather than spiritual discipline and unity, the timing would have differed because it was difficult and invited failure and cowardice.
rows.anchor: اللقاء للمحاربة من طريق العقل والحكمة دون طريق الرياضة والوحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God acted to carry out a decree already ordained and certain to occur.
rows.anchor: ولكن ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا

words: لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One perishes on clear evidence because that evidence is embodied in a body destined to pass away; the truly living have evidence detached from the body and joined to the holy realm, source of enduring life.
rows.anchor: هي كونها مجردة عنه متصلة بعالم القدس الذي هو معدن الحياة الحقيقية الدائم البقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first predecessors are those who reached unity first: the emigrants left the stations of the self, while the Helpers supported the heart with true knowledge against the self.
rows.anchor: الذين سبقوا إلى الوحدة من أهل الصف الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their followers take on the attributes of the Real with a witnessing of beauty and majesty; God is pleased with them through disclosure of the attributes and arrival at the station of contentment, the greatest gate to God.
rows.anchor: أي: بمشاهدة من مشاهدات الجمال والجلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens prepared for them are gardens of acts and attributes, with rivers of knowledge of trust and contentment flowing beneath.
rows.anchor: أنهار علوم التوكل والرضا وما يناسبهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This shared garden does not rule out a separate garden of the essence for the foremost, which is their special attainment.
rows.anchor: وذلك لا ينافي وجود جنة أخرى للسابقين هي جنة الذات واختصاصهم بها لاشتراك الكل في هذه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Confession preserves the light of preparedness and pliancy, showing capacity to repent and a heart’s insight into sin; entrenched darkness would make the person see sin as good.
rows.anchor: هو إبقاء نور الاستعداد ولين الشكيمة وعدم رسوخ ملكة الذنب فيه لأنه ملك الرجوع والتوبة ودليل رؤية قبح الذنب التي لا تكون إلا بنور البصيرة وانفتاح عين القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are at the level of the self-reproaching soul, whose connection to the heart is not yet habitual: sometimes it submits to the heart’s light and does good, and sometimes its veiling qualities prevail and it does evil.
rows.anchor: كانوا في رتبة النفس اللوامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If heart-lights, good deeds, and angelic thoughts prevail until obedience becomes habitual, the soul is restored and saved; if darkness and repeated sin prevail, preparedness disappears and punishment is deserved.
rows.anchor: فإن ترجحت الأنوار القلبية والأعمال الصالحة وتعاقبت عليها الخواطر الملكية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Which side prevails depends on companionship: providence may lead someone to righteous people and their conduct, while abandonment leads to corrupt company and loss.
rows.anchor: لا يكون إلا بالصحبة ومجالسة أصحاب كل واحد من الصنفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s forgiveness covers their dark sins, and His mercy grants success in good works and accepts repentance.
rows.anchor: يغفر لهم السيئات المظلمة ويسترها عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The indefinite forms of wretched and blessed are for exaltation and indicate people wretched or blessed from pre-eternity to eternity.
rows.anchor: لما أطلق الشقي والسعيد منكرين للتعظيم دل على الشقي والسعيد الأزليين الأبديين

words: فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَشَهِيقٌ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fire signifies the self’s punishment through deprivation and painful states; the garden signifies its reward through attaining desires and pleasures.
rows.anchor: المراد بالنار والجنة عذاب النفس بنار الحرمان عن المراد وآلام الهيئات والآثار وثواب النفس بجنة حصول المرادات واللذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the outwardly careful reading, the wretched leave that fire only for worse fires of the heart and spirit, while the blessed move to greater gardens of the heart’s divine disclosure and the spirit’s encounter with God.
rows.anchor: خروج الشقي منها إلى ما هو أشد منه من نيران القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed cannot leave paradise for fire; the unsevered gift supports the permanence of their state and, by opposition, the permanence of the wretched person’s punishment, while the threat in 11:107 is severe.
rows.anchor: لكون الشقي في مقابلة السعيد وخروج السعيد من الجنة إلى النار محال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the deeper account, the wretched remain in fire but move between its levels; with God holding his forelock on a straight path, his own desire drives him to hell, where he enjoys what suits him and the fire becomes pleasure.
rows.anchor: وأما الحقيقة فتحكم بأن الشقي لما كان في المراتب المذكورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commentary cites an unattributed hadith that watercress will grow at the bottom of hell.
rows.anchor: سينبت في قعر جهنم الجرجير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It also cites an unattributed hadith saying a time will come when hell claps its doors and has no one inside.
rows.anchor: يأتي على جهنم زمان يصفق أبوابها ليس فيها أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed traverse the gardens, then the exception refers to their annihilation in the oneness of essence and the ecstasy of love; in selfless witnessing, no separate spirit or other remains, beyond all imaginable description.
rows.anchor: فهو بفنائه في أحدية الذات واحتراقه بلوعة العشق في سبحات الجمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the indefinite nouns indicate kinds rather than exaltation, the wretched may leave for paradise by purifying the soul of dark traits and sin’s consequences, and would not then be wretched forever.
rows.anchor: وإن جعل التنكير في قوله: { شقي وسعيد } للنوعية لا للتعظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What every female bears is the potential perfection carried by each soul; capacity’s wombs increase through purification, refinement, and good company, or diminish through immersion in lusts.
rows.anchor: فيعلم ما تحمل أنثى النفس من ولد الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading is that every perfection has a measure fixed according to each recipient’s capacity.
rows.anchor: من الكمالات { عنده بمقدار } معين على حسب القابلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, every capacity for acceptance was measured eternally by the most holy effusion and neither increases nor decreases.
rows.anchor: أو كل شيء من قوة قبول في استعداد مقدر عنده بمقدار في الأزل من فيضه الأقدس لا يزيد ولا ينقص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also identifies the guide for every people as God, who assigns perfection according to His knowledge of each capacity’s strength and receptivity.
rows.anchor: أو لكل قوم هاد هو الله تعالى كما قال:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows both the unseen receptivity in people’s capacities and the manifest perfections already brought into actuality.
rows.anchor: غيب ما في الاستعدادات من قوة القبول وشهادة الكمالات الحاضرة الخارجة إلى الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His greatness means that He does not fail to give what any capacity requires, for He encompasses all capacities and grants each its due.
rows.anchor: الشأن الذي يجل عن إعطاء ما يقتضيه بعض الاستعدادات بل يسع كلها فيعطيها مقتضياتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His exaltedness means His effusion never ceases, so He does not delay once readiness occurs or give less than it requires.
rows.anchor: عن أن ينقطع فيضه فيتأخر عن حصول الاستعداد وينقص مما يقتضيه

words: لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book leads people from multiplicity to unity, or from the darkness of their created nature to primordial light, or from veils of acts and attributes to the light of the essence.
rows.anchor: من ظلمات الكثرة إلى نور الوحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord’s permission is His gift of readiness through the most holy effusion and His preparation of the causes by which the light becomes actual; without this, no one could lead people out.
rows.anchor: إذ الإذن منه هبة الاستعداد وتهيئة الأسباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the unity reading, the path is of the Mighty, who overcomes multiplicity’s darkness by unity’s light, and the Praiseworthy, perfect in essence.
rows.anchor: القوي الذي يقهر ظلمات الكثرة بنور وحدته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the primordial-nature reading, the Mighty overcomes the soul’s qualities through heart-light, and the Praiseworthy grants virtues and knowledge when nature is purified.
rows.anchor: الذي يقهر صفات النفس بنور القلب { الحميد } الذي يهب نعم الفضائل والعلوم عند صفاء الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the essence reading, the Mighty’s effulgence overpowers attribute-lights and annihilates creatures through His identity; the Praiseworthy gives lasting, perfect existence after their deficient vices pass away.
rows.anchor: الذي يقهر بسبحات ذاته أنوار صفاته ويفنى بحقيقة هويته جميع مخلوقاته الحميد الذي يهب الوجود الباقي الكامل بعد فناء الرذائل الناقص بوجود ذاته وجمال وجهه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers are veiled from unity, primordial nature, or disclosure of the essence; these readings yield corresponding ranks of punishment.
rows.anchor: المحجوبين عن الوحدة أو الفطرة أو تجلي الذات وكشفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The corresponding punishments are love of rivals in the hell of opposition, the fires of vices and soul-qualities, or veils from acts and attributes and deprivation of the essence’s light.
rows.anchor: فهو إما عذاب محبة الأنداد في جحيم التضاد وإما عذاب هيئات الرذائل ونيران صفات النفس ومقتضيات الطبائع أو عذاب حجب الأفعال والصفات والحرمان عن نور الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham represents the spirit speaking through its state as it turns to God seeking direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: الروح بلسان الحال عند التوجه إلى الله في طلب الشهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city is the bodily realm; its safety is freedom from the dominance of soul-qualities, conflict among faculties, and tug of desires.
rows.anchor: من غلبات صفات النفس وتنازع القوى وتجاذب الأهواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His sons are the theoretical and practical intellects, thought, intuition, remembrance, and other faculties; he asks that they not love and worship idols of multiplicity arising from sense, bodily desire, and nature.
rows.anchor: وغيرها. { أن نعبد } أصنام الكثرة عن المشتهيات الحسية

words: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols mislead many by attachment and attraction to them, veiling people from unity.
rows.anchor: بالتعلق بها، والانجذاب إليها، والاحتجاب بها عن الوحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who follow the spirit along the path of tawhid belong to it.
rows.anchor: في سلوك طريق التوحيد { فإنه مني ومن عصاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s forgiveness covers the disobedient person’s dark state with His light, and His mercy grants perfection after forgiveness.
rows.anchor: تستر عنه تلك الهيئة المظلمة بنورك { رحيم } ترحمه بإفاضة الكمال عليه

words: إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offspring are the faculties; the barren valley is bodily nature, devoid of planting in perception, knowledge, gnosis, or virtue, and the forbidden house is the heart.
rows.anchor: أي: وادي الطبيعة الجسمانية الخالية عن زرع الإدراك والعلم والمعرفة والفضيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their prayer is the prayer of intimate communion and unveiling.
rows.anchor: صلاة المناجاة والمكاشفة

words: فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hearts are the human senses, which distinguish the faculties through sensation, supply particular perceptions, and incline to support them through bodily pleasures and the lower direction.
rows.anchor: فتميزهم بأنواع الإحساسات وتمدهم بإدراك الجزئيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fruits are universal knowledge and realities, and gratitude means using those perceptions in pursuit of perfection.
rows.anchor: نعمتك فيستعملون تلك المدركات في طلب الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is hidden is what remains potential in us; what is declared is the perfections brought into actuality, and God knows both the earth of capacity and the heaven of spirit.
rows.anchor: مما فينا بالقوة { وما نعلن } مما أخرجناه إلى الفعل من الكمالات

words: وَهَبَ لِى عَلَىٰ ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gifts of Ishmael and Isaac in old age are the theoretical rational faculty and the scientific faculty, granted at the culmination of perfection.
rows.anchor: العاقلة النظرية { وإسحاق } العلمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears the prayer of preparedness; the author cites the saying, Enough for my asking that He knows my state.
rows.anchor: أي: لسميع لدعاء الاستعداد، كما قال: حسبي من سؤالي علمه بحالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer is to make the speaker maintain the prayer of witnessing, and to make each descendant maintain a prayer appropriate to them.
rows.anchor: صلاة الشهود { ومن ذريتي } كلا منهم مقيم صلاة تخصه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Accepting the prayer means accepting the request for complete annihilation in God.
rows.anchor: أي: طلبي للفناء التام فيك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgive the sin of my existence through the light of Your essence, so that I am not veiled by my own transgression.
rows.anchor: بنور ذاتك ذنب وجودي فلا أحتجب بالطغيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His parents are the receptive and active causes of his existence; he asks to see no one besides God and not suffer a diverted gaze.
rows.anchor: ولما يتسبب لوجودي من القوابل والفواعل فلا أرى غيرك ولا ألتفت إلى سواك فأبتلى بزيغ البصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers are the spiritual powers, and the day of reckoning is when the luminous spiritual and dark psychic dispositions are weighed against each other.
rows.anchor: حساب الهيئات الروحانية النورانية والنفسانية الظلمانية أيها أرجح
